jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.87 hours/week = 75%) from 01.01.2027, pending funding approval, we are looking for 1PhD Position in Developmental Psychology (75% position, E13 TV-L salary scale) – Starting January 1, 2027The Chair of Developmental Psychology at Ruhr-Universität Bochum invites applications for a position as a research associate (m/f/x) within a research project on the development of episodic memory in early childhood. The project will be conducted in close collaboration at two locations: Bochum and Dortmund. The successful candidate will contribute to the planning, execution, analysis, and publication of a longitudinal study involving children aged 3 to 5 years at the research site in Bochum. The project is embedded in a Collaborative Research Centre (CRC). The CRC “Episodic Memory” is an interdisciplinary consortium consisting of researchers from psychology, computational neuroscience, philosophy and neuroscience. The basis for our research is the Scenario Construction Framework which conceptualizes scenarios as mental simulations of past episodes, constructed from episodic memory traces and semantic information. As a member of this team, you will be trained in interdisciplinary research and have access to a broad spectrum of initiatives to support you in your academic journey. The CRC will be housed at the new research building THINK in Bochum, which is not only equipped with cutting edge technology, but also houses a childcare area (which includes, e.g., an outside play area, bedroom), parent child offices, common rooms to foster networking, etc. The position offers the opportunity for scientific qualification through a cumulative PhD. Employment is subject to final approval and funding by the third-party funding provider.Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, until 31.12.2030 (end of project)Start: from 01.01.2027, pending funding approvalApply by:  2026-10-26Your tasks:- Design, implementation, analysis, and publication of studies on the development of episodic memory in early childhood- (Co-)supervision of student assistants and research students- Proactive interdisciplinary collaboration and exchange within and beyond the CRC throughout the research process- Presentation of study results at internal and external events and scientific conferences- Active participation in CRC events- Regular contribution to public relations and science communicationYour profile:Required:- A Master’s degree in Psychology or a closely related field- A strong interest in developmental psychology research on memory and enthusiasm for scientific work- A highly motivated team player who enjoys collaborating with researchers from various disciplines, particularly in the areas of modeling, philosophy, and neuroscience- Proactive problem-solver in daily work- Enjoyment of interacting with parents and children in a research context- Fluent proficiency in German and English (written and spoken)- Excellent methodological, programming, and statistical skillsDesired- Practical experience working with infants and young children in a research context- Prior experience in interdisciplinary research settingshttps://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/fc8a30dca1b0814f19ff94f84bb632ce419c56e30?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/fc8a30dca1b0814f19ff94f84bb632ce419c56e30?ref=AfA)

Universitätsklinikum Düsseldorf (UKD) is the largest hospital in the state capital and one of the most important medical centres in North Rhine-Westphalia. The 9,300 employees of UKD and its subsidiaries ensure that more than 45,000 patients are treated as inpatients and 270,000 as outpatients every year. UKD stands for international excellence in patient care, research and teaching, and for innovative and safe diagnostics, therapy and prevention. Patients benefit from the intensive interdisciplinary cooperation of 60 clinics and institutes. The particular strength of the university hospital lies in the close interlinking of clinical care and research for the safe application of new methods. At UKD, the medicine of tomorrow is created. Every day.The Institute of Pathology at Universitätsklinikum Düsseldorf (Director: Univ.-Prof. Dr. Irene Esposito), in a joint project with the Institute of Pharmaceutical Biology and Biotechnology (Prof. Dr. Nicole Teusch), is offering, at the earliest possible date, aPhD position (m/f/d)in the field of 3D Tumour Biology for Personalized Drug Discovery.Part-time, 65% of the weekly working hours.The appointment is initially limited to a period of 2 years, with the option of extension. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Employment Contracts in Academia (WissZeitVG, § 2 para. 1).Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the deadliest cancers, largely because its dense stromal and immune microenvironment drives therapy resistance that conventional cell-line models and 3D organoids fail to capture. In this joint project, we are looking for a PhD candidate to characterise an ex vivo PDAC tissue model that preserves native tissue architecture together with the stromal and immune compartments, and to develop it into a working platform for drug testing and screening. The successful candidate will be jointly supervised by both groups and fully embedded in each - a rare opportunity to combine pathology, tumour biology and pharmacology within one project.Establishment and characterisation of ex vivo PDAC tissue cultures (murine and human)Histopathology and digital image analysis (QuPath)Generation of transcriptomic data and independent downstream bioinformatic analysisAnalysis of (cell-type-specific) drug responsesValidation of the findings in patient-derived tumour tissueMaster's degree in biology, biomedicine, biochemistry, or a related life-science disciplineResearch experience in cell and/or tissue culture and in standard molecular biology methodsInterest in transcriptomic data and the willingness to grow into its bioinformatic analysisA plus, not a must: prior experience with histology, primary tissue culture or RNA-seq analysis, or work with animal-derived material (FELASA certification an advantage)Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work efficiently both independently and in a teamExcellent English communication skills (written and spoken)A fully funded, three-year position at the interface of pathology, tumour biology and pharmacology25.025 weekly working hoursAccess to the infrastructure and expertise of two established institutesState-of-the-art facilities and current methodsInternational, engaged teams with structured doctoral supervision, including regular project meetingsSupport for conference attendance and method trainingStructured graduate programmes, e.g. through the Düsseldorf School of Oncology (DSO)All benefits customary in the public sector, e.g. a company supplementary pensionAffordable catering optionsStaff accommodationDay-care facilities for children

jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.87 hours/week = 75%) from 01.01.2027, pending funding approval, we are looking for 1Doctoral Position (m,f,x) in Computational Neuroscience (Project Z02)Are you curious about how the human brain stores and retrieves memories? You want bridge the gap between academia and the wider public? The Collaborative Research Center “Episodic Memory” (CRC 1844) is an interdisciplinary consortium consisting of researchers from psychology, computational neuroscience, philosophy and neuroscience. The basis for our research is the Scenario Construction Framework which conceptualizes scenarios as mental simulations of past episodes, constructed from episodic memory traces and semantic information.We are actively seeking a talented PhD student to join our science communication project within the CRC 1844, which develops a digital serious game for citizen science, establishing a bidirectional bridge between episodic memory (EM) research and the general public. The Department of Pediatric Oncology, Hematology and Clinical Immunology at the University Hospital Düsseldorf (UKD) at the Heinrich Heine University (HHU), headed by Prof. Dr. Arndt Borkhardt, is one of the leading clinical centers for the diagnosis and treatment of childhood cancer in Germany. The clinic is part of the University Tumor Center (UTZ) at the UKD and the Center for Integrative Oncology Aachen-Bonn-Cologne-Düsseldorf (CIO-ABCD), which is funded by the German Cancer Aid. It is a founding partner of the German Consortium for Translational Cancer Research (DKTK) Essen-Düsseldorf and participates in international research consortia and study groups. The clinic operates a fully equipped research laboratory (safety level 1 and 2 according to the Genetic Engineering/Biotechnology Ordinance, including a GMP, next generation sequencing, flow cytometry, life cell imaging, and high-throughput drug testing facility) with 5 research groups and >30 staff working in an interdisciplinary manner on the fundamentals of childhood cancer and in the field of therapy optimization. We are seeking a highly motivated and creative PhD Student to join our research program in the field of amino acid homeostasis and cancer metabolism, with an anticipated start date of 02/2027. The successful candidate will work on the ERC-funded project “POWERFUL” (Deciphering how cancer cells fuel themselves to advance personalized treatment strategies).The PhD student will take a leading role in understanding how cancer cells sense and respond to amino acid availability, and how to translate this knowledge into precision-based treatment strategies. This position requires scientific independence and the opportunity to contribute intellectually to experimental design, data interpretation, and publication strategy. The candidate will employ and further develop advanced experimental models and methodologies, including organoid systems, patient-derived xenografts (PDXs), CRISPR/Cas9-based genome editing, multiparameter flow cytometry, confocal microscopy, FRET assays, protein interaction and signaling assays, as well as in vitro and in vivo drug screening approaches.Candidates should have a very good understanding of and experience with standard molecular biology techniques including but not limited to tissue culture, genome editing, FACS analysis, confocal microscopy, immunoblot, and PCR/qPCR. Experience with animal models is a plus (as is FELASA B certification). The employment contract will be concluded with Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf.Applications from women are expressly welcome. The German Diabetes Center (DDZ) is the Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. The DDZ is an interdisciplinary research center linking molecular and cell biological basic with clinical and epidemiological research approaches. The DDZ has the aim to develop new approaches for prevention, early detection and diagnosis of diabetes mellitus and to improve therapy and treatment of its complications.The Institute for Clinical Diabetology (Director: Prof. Dr. Michael Roden) is looking for anEpidemiologist (postdoc - m/f/d) We are searching for a candidate with (1) a doctoral degree in epidemiology, (bio)statistics or a comparable discipline, (2) the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner with physicians and life scientists, and (3) knowledge of epidemiological methodology and statistical analysis systems (e.g. SAS or R). In addition, excellent writing and communication skills in English are required. Experience in the analysis of proteomics data would be desirable.The project will be a collaboration between the research group Inflammation (Prof. Dr. Christian Herder) and the Clinical Study Center (Prof. Dr. Robert Wagner, PD Dr. Oana-Patricia Zaharia) at DDZ. Tasks include planning epidemiological analyses within different cohort studies, performing statistical analyses in projects related to the link between inflammation, diabetes and cardiovascular complications, and communicating results in conferences and publications. The coordination of projects with internal and external partners is important as the position will be linked to projects with the Department of Cardiology, Pulmonology and Vascular Medicine at the Medical Faculty, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf.An exciting and diversified fulltime job in a multidisciplinary team. The project should start on the earliest possible start date with a 3-year-contract.A salary as based on qualification and experience according to TV-L in its current version for North Rhine-Westphalia.Family-friendly working conditions and equal gender policy. Since May 2011, the DDZ is a “Career and Family” audit-acknowledged center.Women are especially encouraged to apply, and in the case of equal qualification will be given preference. Similarly, persons with disabilities will be given preference.

jobs.description: As a Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you will play a key role in shaping the performance of one of Europe's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. By transforming manufacturing data into actionable insights, you will influence critical decisions on productivity, cycle time and capacity development. Your expertise will directly support the ramp-up of Infineon's €5 billion Smart Power Fab while helping to shape the future of Industrial Engineering in Dresden.Your RoleKey responsibilities in your new role- Serve as the Factory Physics authority for the Dresden site, developing models that translate manufacturing complexity into actionable insights for throughput, cycle time, variability and bottleneck management- Lead high-impact productivity programs, from identifying optimization potential to driving implementation and sustainable business results- Provide expert guidance on complex Industrial Engineering challenges and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across Operations, Planning, Technology, Equipment Engineering and Finance- Define and continuously enhance local performance benchmarks, assessment methods and analytical approaches to support data-driven decision-making- Strengthen the Industrial Engineering network through active collaboration and best-practice exchange with colleagues across Infineon's Front-End manufacturing sitesYour ProfileAs Principal Expert Factory Physics & Fab Performance (f/m/div), you own the Factory Physics competence for the Dresden site. You model the fab as a physical system, identify the real bottlenecks and bring recommendations to decision — not to filing. Your work is directly visible: in the ramp decisions of the Smart Power Fab and in the strategic roadmap of the IE cluster. You build where others optimize and shape how Industrial Engineering in Dresden will make impact over the coming years.Qualifications and skills to help you succeed- Master's or Diploma degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Operations Research or a comparable field; PhD is a plus- 6–10 years of relevant experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Science or Operations Research — with demonstrable Factory Physics application in a technology-intensive high-volume manufacturing environment- Strong expertise in Factory Physics methods, including throughput, variability, bottleneck and cycle-time analysis- Proficiency in SQL, Python or R and common BI tools for data-driven decision-making- Experience leading cross-functional program teams with 7–8-digit business impact and confidently engaging stakeholders up to senior management- Hands-on experience with fab analytics and simulation tools such as Smart OEE, AutoSched, D-Simcon or AnyLogic (nice to have)- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken (B2-Niveau)Contact:Nicole Hippmann, LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicole-hippmann-01b036172/)#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. jobs.description: As a university of applied sciences, we are particularly committed tosustainable development. development and application of state-of-the-art datascience models in close collaboration with consortium partners frombiomechanics, medicine, and psychology/psychosomatics.- Presenting research findings at national and international conferences andsymposia.- Implementing modern data management standards and, where possible, openscience publication of research outputs (metadata, analytical workflows, code,documentation, etc.) in compliance with the FAIR principles (Findable,Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable).- Interdisciplinary collaboration within the research team.Profile / Requirements:- A completed university degree (Master's degree or an internationallyequivalent degree) in physiotherapy, sports science, data science, statistics,medicine, health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, or a related field, as wellas relevant research experience.- Fulfilment of the formal criteria for enrolment as a doctoral candidate inthe "Social Work and Health" department PKNRW)https://www.pknrw.de/abteilungen/soziales-und-gesundheit/gestaltung-des-sozialen-und-gesundheitlichen-wandels- Very good written and spoken English skills (scientific communication) arerequired for the position; fluent German skills are not required.- Experience collaborating in interdisciplinary teams.- Proven experience in statistical analysis.- Experience in machine learning and artificial intelligence is advantageous.- Experience in project coordination, programming (e.g., R, Python), as wellas in preparing scientific publications and grant applications is desirable.What We What You'll Be Working OnAt Lime Connect, AI agents already handle customer service conversations for our clients. Now we want to make them better: measurably, and regardless of which language model is currently ahead. That's why we're looking for someone with a backend background who feels at home in the AI world:• You build and improve our AI agents, from the agent loop and tool calling to context management.• You set up our architecture so we can switch language models without rebuilding everything.• Before anything goes live, you use evals to check whether it's actually better. For example, with LLM-as-a-judge and test cases from real customer conversations.• You turn feedback from the service teams working with our agents into concrete improvements. That way, the system keeps getting better step by step.• You connect APIs, MCP tools and website crawling, so our agents have the right knowledge and the right tools.• Within the backend team, you're the go-to person for AI and work closely with Product.What Makes You a Fit• Around five years of backend development, including at least a year building language-model features that real users rely on.• You've built AI agents before and know what context windows, tool calling and prompting mean in practice.• You've worked hands-on with RAG and vector databases.• You have experience with evals, for example with Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or LangSmith, or you've built something similar yourself.• Ideally, you know Pydantic AI, LiteLLM or similar libraries.• You follow what's happening in AI, try new things quickly and take ownership of your topics.• You speak German and English fluently.What’s in It for YouHEALTH & SPORTS• 600 € health budget per year, including 24/7 medical advice — also for family members in your household• Subsidised Urban Sports Club membership (20 € monthly contribution)DEVELOPMENT & GROWTH• Learning budget for courses, books and conferences• Free access to Udemy, Masterclass and language learning apps• Leadership programmes such as "Next Gen" and "Effective Manager"TEAM & CULTURE• Weekly FIKA, movie nights, book club and regular get-togethers and team events• International summer party together with our colleagues in the NordicsWORK ENVIRONMENT• Office-first setup: 3 days in our Cologne office at the MediaPark, 2 days remote• 360° view across Cologne from the 14th floor• Workation within the EU• Snacks, cereal bar and drinks in the officeCOMPENSATION & BENEFITS• Company pension scheme via Zurich with a 30 % employer contribution• Job ticket or mobility budget, plus free parking at the MediaPark• Corporate benefits• 28 days of holiday, plus Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve off• Up to 5 days of special leave for important life eventsAbout usAutomated where it makes sense. Personal where it counts.We are Lime Connect – an AI-first company and one of the top software scale-ups in Cologne. AI isn't an add-on for us, it's the core of what we build: our leading customer messaging solution for customer service, sales, and marketing combines AI agents, web chat, and mobile messaging, already automating the majority of all customer inquiries today. As part of Lime Technologies, our Swedish parent company, we combine international perspectives with the drive of a company actively shaping its next stage of growth. With us, you help shape things, not just execute them – with real ownership from day one, in a dynamic environment, and a culture that values results just as much as people. Weekly fika included.

jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionBoehringer Ingelheim's HR function is entering the era of agentic AI. Building on our established AI, we are launching a dedicated Data & AI initiative to reimagine how HR services and processes are delivered across the globe. As Senior AI Expert, you will be the technical and strategic driving force behind this transformation: designing, building and scaling agentic AI solutions that make HR services smarter, faster and more personal for employees, managers and HR experts alike.You will join the IT Group Functions & Supply Chain (GFS) Global HR Systems team responsible for our core global HR platforms SAP SuccessFactors and act as the central Data & AI lead for the wider IT GFS Human Resources organization, partnering closely with Corporate HR Centers of Excellence, GBS Process Management, HR stakeholders in the countries and other IT functions like the IT Enterprise Service Management team bringing ServiceNow to the center of HR Service Management.Tasks & responsibilities- Own and drive the Data & AI initiative for HR: define the roadmap, prioritize use cases and lead the transition of HR services and processes towards agentic, AI-first ways of working.- Design, build and industrialize agentic AI solutions and multi-step AI workflows for HR processes using platforms such as SAP Business AI/ SAPJoule, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dify, ServiceNow Now Assist and more.- Define and safeguard the data foundation for AI in HR: identify and prioritize HR "crown jewel" datasets, drive onboarding of AI-/agentic-AI-ready data products, and ensure data quality, semantics and governance meet the requirements of generative and agentic AI use cases.- Establish and champion agentic AI governance for HR in line with BI's enterprise Responsible AI frameworks: agent lifecycle and ownership, permissions and data boundaries, human oversight, monitoring, and audit readiness.- Build the business case, cost/benefit assessment and prioritization matrix for AI use cases in HR and translate them into a concrete execution roadmap with measurable business outcomes.Requirements- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Human Resources, or a related field, or a Bachelor's degree with more professional experience.- Several years of experience in AI and data-driven solution design, ideally combined with exposure to HR technology, HR processes, or HR IT landscapes within a global organization.- Proven experience leading or significantly contributing to AI, automation, or digital transformation initiatives from ideation through implementation and scaling.- Hands-on experience with SAP Business AI and SAP Joule, including embedded AI capabilities across SAP SuccessFactors and the ability to configure, extend, and govern AI solutions.- Practical knowledge of agentic AI concepts and platforms, including low-code/no-code and code-based AI development environments.- Understanding of AI data foundations, including data products, data quality, semantic and metadata management, and familiarity with enterprise data and AI ecosystems.- Familiarity with HR technology landscapes such as SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, Degreed, Payroll, and Time Management systems.- Strong stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills, combined with strategic thinking, a hands-on approach, experience working across global and cross-functional teams, intercultural awareness- Fluency in English; German language skills are an advantage.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more?
